row.title: A pipe to tee hid a failed embedding step and an empty run was committed
row.body: Observed live in https://github.com/ultrastable/practical-solutions/actions/runs/44813063061: the run raced the model-route deploy, embedding failed in 3 seconds, the step still ended success because the GitHub default shell has no pipefail, and an empty run tuned the threshold. Fixed and merged in practical-solutions#173 (a run with no vectors records nothing and exits 2; the step uses shell: bash). Verified: node tools/connections.mjs --offline exits 2 and writes nothing. Any workflow that pipes a step that matters to tee needs pipefail.

title: A pipe to tee hid a failed embedding step and an empty run was committed
